scope: Saved-output comparison against the jointly training-refitted uninhibited comparator, conditional on shared fixed spatial and mark laws.

full_regime_eligibility.unavailable_reason: One required original history is unresolved in each unavailable regime; no complete-case-only full-regime aggregate.

complete_regime_findings: All three raw inhibition procedures have negative mean held-out joint-score gain in each complete regime.
In S4 both training BIC procedures return the exact uninhibited floor for all histories.
In S7 the designated raw total-inhibition comparison has negative mean and median gain and eight strictly positive wins among twenty histories.
The designated raw immigrant-inhibition comparison in S5 has no full-regime summary because the permanent optimizer-cap unknown remains unavailable.
inference_scope: Pointwise Wilson intervals concern the strict-win fraction. These saved synthetic comparisons do not establish mean-gain uncertainty, simultaneous inference, physical mechanism, global optimization or forecast validity.
